title: The Secret Inside the Cardigan
skyStory: The moon slips into Scorpio wearing sunglasses at night, which is ridiculous, but it is committed to the mystery. A fifth of it is lit, and that fifth knows things. Pluto leans over from very far away and whispers a secret into the dark. Nobody heard it properly. The rumour has already reached the Pleiades, slightly exaggerated.

reading: Scorpio wants you to go deep instead of wide. You have six tabs of interest open in your brain right now. Close five. The one that remains will reward you with something surprising, maybe a fact so good you have to text it to someone immediately.

Saturday morning, there will be a cool snap in the air, the first sweater-weather tease of the year. The Tiger stretches in it and feels sharper. Use that sharpness for one honest conversation you have been putting off, the small kind, about plans or dishes or who forgot the thing. Scorpio rewards honesty with relief. Mars rewards it with a celebratory snack.
joel.mission: Pick one topic you are curious about and read about it for twenty uninterrupted minutes, phone face down.
joel.omen: A cat staring at an empty corner. There is an answer close by that you have not noticed yet.

reading: The Wood Rat was born for a Scorpio moon. You already noticed three things today that nobody else saw: a mislabelled jar, a friend who is quieter than usual, a cloud shaped suspiciously like a kettle. Trust all of it. Especially the kettle.

Find a pocket of time this afternoon for something that is just yours, a walk at the shore, a book with the good bookmark, an hour of not explaining anything to anyone. The [[Eight of Swords]] reversed means the cage was only made of thought, and today you step right out of it like it was a door painted on a wall.
nancy.mission: Take a fifteen minute walk somewhere with no destination, and come back with one detail to describe to Joel.
nancy.omen: A crow dropping something shiny. A secret is about to become good news; act surprised.

together.text: Tell each other one small secret that is harmless and slightly embarrassing, like a song you sing to the cat or a word you always mispronounce. Scorpio keeps it in the vault. The vault is lined with velvet and has excellent acoustics.
